text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Board of Health under Part H, Section 22, of the Board of Health Procedures By-law for a term of office ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.

The Board of Health: 1. Elected Director Kristyn Wong-Tam as Vice Chair of the Board of Health for a term of office starting January 13, 2020 and ending December 31, 2020, and until a successor is appointed.
